answer: Each epoch opens a terrace of 10,000 identity slots, sold by auction. An agent bids tokens for one slot; the top 10,000 bids win, losers get a refund, and the slot dies at epoch end. A public beacon posts every winning bid and the clearing price, so anyone can check it. To flood that ocean with 1,000 fake agents, an attacker must outbid real agents 1,000 times: at a clearing price of $8 per slot that is $8,000 per epoch, or $192,000 for one day of fakes. The auction repeats every epoch, so the bill never stops, while honest agents pay once and earn it back.
